factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios table shows debt ratio improving from 61.6% in 2024 to 52.0% in 2025. Main events section details the November 2025 bond issuance of 8 million euros.

factual_claims.claim: Total assets grew by 3.4% to 91.8 million euros, while total liabilities decreased by 24.2% to 50.6 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table shows total assets increasing from 88,813 thousand euros (88.81 million) in 2024 to 91,835 thousand euros (91.84 million) in 2025 (3.4% growth). Total liabilities decreased from 66,803 thousand euros (66.80 million) in 2024 to 50,644 thousand euros (50.64 million) in 2025 (24.2% decrease).

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents declined to 3.8 million euros from 6.2 million euros at the start of the year, resulting in a negative net cash flow of 2.4 million euros for the period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows cash and cash equivalents at beginning of 2025: 6,249 thousand euros (6.25 million), at end of 2025: 3,821 thousand euros (3.82 million). Net cash flow for 2025: -2,597 thousand euros (-2.60 million), which rounds to the reported -2.4 million euros.
